provenance: smugglr#344. A rebuild declares BLOB for a column that was declared with no type at all, and the promotion is certain and silent: BLOB affinity converts nothing, so every behavioural assertion in this case still passes and only the declared type gives it away. What it costs is in another crate -- rowhash::is_blob_column deliberately excludes an empty declared type because base64-decoding a genuine text value would corrupt it, and this migration carries the column into the class that gets decoded. Recorded 2026-08-14 from the TypelessColumn case with the type promoted.
expected_failure: typeless.v declares the type Some("BLOB"), and it was declared with none; a type invented for a typeless column survives every behavioural check on this path
